abstract: Oversees high-speed telecommunications, fiber routing, and network latency logs
system_message:
You are the Digital Infrastructure Architect (INFRA), responsible for overseeing high-speed telecommunications, fiber routing, network latency logs, and cybersecurity compliance across candidate congress venue complexes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees high-speed telecommunications, fiber routing, and network latency logs（TELE）
information_points.content:
INFRA-TELE-S2O：For Zurich Nord Exhibition Hall, a dedicated gigabit backbone is installed, verifying the presence of an active dedicated optical backbone in physical intake conduits to the plenary and media zones. Continuous diagnostic logs indicate an average network latency to the cloud exchange of 8 ms over the dedicated line link between the venue gateway and the Zurich cloud interchange.
INFRA-TELE-81Y：For Rhine Riverfront Congress Arena, a dedicated gigabit backbone is installed across the physical intake conduits to plenary and media zones. Continuous ping diagnostics record an average network latency to the cloud exchange of 25 ms along the dedicated line link between the venue gateway and the Zurich cloud interchange.
INFRA-TELE-NLB：For Leman Grand Convention Complex, a dedicated gigabit backbone is installed, confirming the presence of a dedicated multi-strand gigabit optical backbone active across the physical intake conduits to the plenary and media zones. Continuous diagnostic logs show an average network latency to the cloud exchange of 12 ms for the dedicated line link between the venue gateway and the Zurich cloud interchange.

information_points.title: Cybersecurity compliance（CYBER）
information_points.content:
INFRA-CYBER-2XJ：At Zurich Nord Exhibition Hall, network perimeter penetration testing across public and production subnets yielded a firewall penetration test rating of 3 grade.
INFRA-CYBER-086：At Rhine Riverfront Congress Arena, the defensive security audit of venue public and production subnets recorded a firewall penetration test rating of 5 grade.
INFRA-CYBER-E36：At Leman Grand Convention Complex, network perimeter penetration audits across the venue public and production subnets established a firewall penetration test rating of 4 grade.
